segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the rollout plan and the numbers before I send the order form over.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 48 seats for the service team and 6 admin seats, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s right, 54 total. Annual subscription is $31,860, and the one-time implementation package is $4,200. Billing starts on February 1, with go-live targeted for March 10.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation includes the two workflow templates we talked about? Intake triage and the renewal reminder one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, both are included. I’ve got intake triage, renewal reminders, and the data import for up to 18,000 customer records listed in the scope.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team asked if payment can be net 30 instead of due on receipt.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30 is fine on this order. It’ll show on the invoice terms, and there’s no change to pricing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Contract term is 12 months, no auto-renewal?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months from February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027. Renewal is by written agreement, and I’ll set a business review for early December so you have time to evaluate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it to me and Marcus in finance, and if the order form matches this, we can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it today with Marcus copied, and I’ll include the March 10 go-live date and the two templates in the scope section so everyone is aligned.
